name: litescrape-mcp-server
description: Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps search results, free without an API key.
long_description: Live search results straight from Google Search, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps as structured JSON, through the Litescrape API. Works with no API key and no account from a free daily allowance per network (25 Google Search calls, 50 each for Bing, DuckDuckGo and Google Maps). Add a Litescrape API key for Google AI Mode, Google AI Overview and Google Shopping, and to lift every limit. Every tool returns the API's JSON unchanged after a one-line summary; result_groups keeps only the groups you need.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web through Google and return ranked organic results (title, link, snippet) as JSON. Fast mode: no Knowledge Graph, ads or AI modules; use google_search for the full results page. Free without an API key (shares the google_search allowance).

hl.description: Language code such as "en" or "en-GB"; default en

location.description: Named search origin such as "Austin, Texas"; conflicts with uule and lat/lon

num.description: Requested result count, 1-100; Google may return fewer

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

tools.name: google_search
tools.description: Fetch a first-party Google Search results page as JSON: organic_results plus whichever modules Google served (knowledge_graph, answer_box, ai_overview, ads, related_questions, related_searches, local_results, top_stories, inline_videos and more). Supports localization, verticals (news, videos, local, shopping, patents), date filters and site restriction. Free without an API key: 25 calls per network per day.

q.description: Search query; required unless ludocid or kgmid is supplied

ludocid.description: Google CID of a local entity, for a targeted lookup

kgmid.description: Knowledge Graph machine ID such as /m/0k8z

location.description: Named search origin such as "Austin, Texas"; conflicts with uule and lat/lon

uule.description: Pre-encoded Google location token; conflicts with location

radius.description: Radius in meters around the location or coordinates

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.co.uk; default google.com

hl.description: Language code such as "en" or "en-GB"; default en

tbs.description: Google search-filter string, e.g. qdr:w for the past week

tbm.description: Vertical: lcl local, vid videos, nws news, shop shopping, pts patents

as_qdr.description: Date range: d, w, m or y with an optional count, e.g. d7 for the past week

num.description: Requested result count, 1-100; Google may return fewer

fast_mode.description: true returns only organic_results (faster and smaller); skips AI Overview, Knowledge Graph, ads and every other module

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

tools.name: bing_search
tools.description: Fetch a Bing web search results page as JSON: organic_results plus the modules Bing served (answer_box, knowledge_graph, copilot_answer, ads, related_questions, inline_videos, top_stories and more). Free without an API key: 50 calls per network per day.

q.description: Search query; Bing operators are preserved

mkt.description: Market such as en-US; conflicts with cc

cc.description: Two-letter country code; conflicts with mkt

first.description: One-based organic result offset for pagination; default 1

filters.description: Native Bing display or date filters

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

tools.name: duckduckgo_search
tools.description: Fetch ranked DuckDuckGo web results (organic_results with title, link, snippet) with region, safety and date controls. Free without an API key: 50 calls per network per day.

kl.description: Region and language token such as us-en

search_assist.description: Default true; cannot be combined with m

df.description: Date filter: d, w, m, y, or YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD

m.description: Result count 1-50; cannot be combined with search_assist

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

tools.name: google_maps
tools.description: Search Google Maps for places (local_results with name, address, rating, reviews, hours, phone, website, coordinates) or fetch one exact place (place_results) by place_id, data_cid or data sequence. Filter by price, rating and opening hours. Free without an API key: 50 calls per network per day.

type.description: search (default) for a query, or place for one exact place identified by place_id, data_cid or data

location.description: Named search origin such as "Austin, Texas"; conflicts with uule and lat/lon

z.description: Zoom 3-30; use with location or lat/lon

m.description: Radius in meters; use with location or lat/lon

nearby.description: Restrict results to places near the viewport

place_id.description: Exact place by Google place ID

data_cid.description: Exact place by decimal Google CID

data.description: Exact place by Google Maps data sequence

hl.description: Language code such as "en" or "en-GB"; default en

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.co.uk; default google.com

open_state.description: Open now, or open 24 hours; cannot combine with open_on_day

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

ludocid.description: Google CID of a local entity, for a targeted lookup

kgmid.description: Knowledge Graph machine ID such as /m/0k8z

location.description: Named search origin such as "Austin, Texas"; conflicts with uule and lat/lon

uule.description: Pre-encoded Google location token; conflicts with location

radius.description: Radius in meters around the location or coordinates

tbm.description: Vertical: lcl local, vid videos, nws news, shop shopping, pts patents

tools.name: google_ai_mode
tools.description: Ask Google AI Mode a question and return its generated answer (ordered text_blocks: paragraphs, headings, lists, tables, code) with the sources it cited (references). Set continuable to get a token for follow-up questions; image_url adds a picture to the prompt. Slow: answers are generated per request. Requires an API key.

location.description: Named search origin such as "Austin, Texas"; conflicts with uule and lat/lon

uule.description: Pre-encoded Google location token; conflicts with location

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.co.uk; default google.com

hl.description: Language code such as "en" or "en-GB"; default en

continuable.description: Return a subsequent_request_token so the conversation can continue

subsequent_request_token.description: Token from a previous continuable answer; send with a new q. Expires after 30 minutes; cannot combine with image_url

image_url.description: Public http(s) image to include in the prompt; cannot combine with a token

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

tools.name: google_shopping
tools.description: Search Google Shopping and return the product grid (shopping_results with title, price, source, rating, thumbnail), category blocks, sponsored listings and the refinement chips Google renders (filters). Price bounds, sale, shipping and small business refinements are mutually exclusive; sort_by combines with one of them. Requires an API key.

q.description: Product query; required unless shoprs is supplied

location.description: Named search origin such as "Austin, Texas"; conflicts with uule and lat/lon

uule.description: Pre-encoded Google location token; conflicts with location

google_domain.description: Google domain such as google.co.uk; default google.com

hl.description: Language code such as "en" or "en-GB"; default en

shoprs.description: Refinement token from a previous response's filters

sort_by.description: 1 price low to high, 2 price high to low, 3 rating, 4 relevance

result_groups.description: Return only these top-level result groups, e.g. ["organic_results", "knowledge_graph"]; omit for the complete response. search_metadata is always kept

api_key.title: Litescrape API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the free keyless allowance. A key unlocks Google AI Mode, AI Overview and Shopping and removes the daily limits; get one at https://litescrape.com.
